title: Three visions of Heaven
text: believe it or not heaven is a place that actually exists heaven is the experience of absolute unqualified perfection and if you want to be free if you want to understand what enlightenment is all about having this kind of experience is very very important because it's only this kind of experience that can give us the kind of spiritual self-confidence that can change absolutely everything but what's very interesting is that heaven I've discovered doesn't exist in one place in one space in one state in one domain it actually exists in three different places in three different states of consciousness in three different domains haven't has three different vantage points and that's what I want to speak about because understanding these the three different locations of heaven three different vantage points of heaven gives us three different perspectives on the meaning and significance of spiritual freedom and enlightenment and that's very important if we want to be able to make deep and profound sense out of the most significant kind of spiritual experience as possible to have [Music]
